The Founders\' Wager — every chapter you\'ve lived

A rusty garage on the edge of the galaxy. A key, an old coin and a chip. That is everything Aurora Vance — the legendary founder of Vance & Vex — left to her heir.\n\nThat is everything she left to you.

Connection established. I am LIA, Aurora\'s intelligence. Before disappearing, my creator signed a wager with her old partner, Magnus Vex — the man who stole the company from her: if her heir builds an empire that surpasses VexCorp, he gives back everything he took.

That coin in your hand is the first one they ever earned together. Aurora enchanted it with an echo of fortune: every time you touch it, it replays her very first sale.\n\nTouch it. Touch it many times.

Every tap mints coins. Chained taps build COMBOS, and sometimes you strike a PERFECT ECHO — a critical. With those earnings we will rebuild Aurora\'s business network.\n\nVex thinks this is a joke. Let\'s make him choke on it.
Your first business reopens its doors. The signal reaches Nexus Prime in milliseconds. At the top of the VexCorp tower, someone smiles.
«Well, well. The garage cockroach bought itself a business. Do you know how many like you I have crushed? Enjoy your lemonade stand, heir. The Wager expires when I say it does.»

Ignore him. Every business produces coins per second — even while you sleep, which is something Vex forbids his own employees to do. Stack up units: at each milestone (10, 25, 50…) the market remembers the Vance name and production DOUBLES.
Aurora raised ten markets, from this Garage all the way to Nexus Prime. Vex controls every one of them. Each world you unlock is territory you tear from his hands in front of the whole galaxy.
«Expanding, are we? Adorable. Those markets carry my name on every lamppost. I\'ll let you play in them… until taking them from you hurts more.»
Each world multiplies your production and unlocks exclusive businesses. The last one is Nexus Prime — Vex\'s own tower. That is where the Wager will be settled.
Every screen in the galaxy lights up at once. THE VEX CHALLENGES — the show where the magnate humiliates his rivals live on air.\n\nTonight\'s guest: you.
«I figured the galaxy deserves a laugh. Accept my challenges, heir. When you lose, billions will be watching. And when you win… bah. You won\'t win.»

Every victory comes straight out of his pocket: the prizes are paid by VexCorp. The galactic regulator caps the daily attempts — use them all. Humiliating him in his own circus is priceless. Well, no: it has a price, and you collect it.
At VexCorp there are no employees, only «Performance Units». Rest is penalised. Pets are forbidden. And tonight, in a clandestine hangar, dozens of them are waiting to meet Aurora\'s heir.
The underground job fairs let you hire VexCorp defectors. They come with their experience, their talent… and their scars. Treat them better than Vex did. It isn\'t hard; the bar is underground.

Assign workers to your businesses to multiply production. Negotiate real contracts: salary, schedule, the right to strike. Pay them on time — or they will do to you what Aurora herself once did inside VexCorp: organise the first strike in its history.

There is something I must tell you. VexCorp runs a division called Project Chimera: they engineer cosmic creatures as luxury products… with planned obsolescence. Aurora stole the first litter and founded The Sanctuary.
The creature watches you from its carrier. On its side, a VexCorp serial number crossed out with golden paint. Below it, in Aurora\'s handwriting: «You are not a product anymore.»

Every chimera you adopt funds the rescue of the next one. Feed them, play with them, heal them: a happy chimera empowers your whole empire. And remember — your workers defected over how Vex treats living beings. Neglect the Sanctuary and they will lose faith in you.

Fascinating. In freedom, the chimeras do something Vex\'s laboratories never achieved: they blend their bloodlines. Your new hatchling will inherit traits from both parents — you will see one parent\'s body and the other\'s features.
Incubation takes real time. And sometimes a gene VexCorp suppressed wakes up: a RARE MUTATION, with gifts not even Aurora documented. Every free-born generation is living proof that Vex was wrong.
«You are BREEDING my chimeras? That is VexCorp intellectual property, heir. My lawyers are already drafting the lawsuit. My scientists, on the other hand, want to know how on earth you did it.»
Your empire now shows up in the galactic indices. Nobody laughs in Nexus Prime anymore. And then the document arrives, with golden letterhead and a legal seal: PHOENIX CLAUSE — READY TO INVOKE.

«Did you think the Wager was clean? Read the fine print, heir: whenever your valuation threatens mine, I may reset the entire market. Your businesses, your coins, your progress: ashes. And I can do it again. And again. Aurora signed it. Why was she smiling? I never understood.»

I understand it. Aurora signed because the clause has a flaw: it erases the numbers, but it CANNOT ERASE REPUTATION. Every rebirth keeps your Renown, and the market will welcome you back producing more than before.

That is PRESTIGE: let Vex burn your empire down, and rise stronger. You keep your Renown (a permanent multiplier), your chimeras and your staff. Every time he invokes the clause it costs him more and slows you less. His weapon wears down. Yours sharpens.

The whole market flickers and resets. Where yesterday stood an empire, today there is a garage. But the headlines are not about the reset — they are about the heir of Aurora forcing Magnus Vex to fire his ultimate weapon.\n\nAnd you are still here.
Memory unlocked — Aurora Vance, 12 years ago: «One day Magnus will burn everything you build. Let him. Empires are things that catch fire, little one. Names are not. Build a name.»
Your Renown is already working: you produce more than you did yesterday at this hour. Up in the tower, Vex has stopped smiling.\n\nLet\'s do it again.
The markets tremble without warning. A crisis a little too convenient, a blackout a little too precise. The VexCorp seal appears nowhere — and that is exactly his signature.

Vex cannot touch the Wager, but he can tilt the board: sabotage, audits, cyberattacks. The good news: Aurora\'s old allies pull strings too. Booms, festivals, grants… not everything unexpected is an enemy.

Each event offers you CHOICES with consequences for production, staff or stability. If you don\'t choose, fate will choose for you — and fate has a contract with VexCorp. Watch the galactic stability: it measures who is winning this arm-wrestle.
Something golden crosses the sky and, for a heartbeat, every machine you own produces in unison. You touched it.\n\nAnd it greeted you back.

Analysis… impossible. That was Aurora\'s lucky amulet. She wore it the day the company was founded and swore she would take it «beyond the Rim». Apparently it is still in orbit. And apparently… it knows you.

When the golden comet crosses your screen, CATCH IT: it sheds echoes of Aurora\'s luck — production frenzies, coin showers, star shards. It is not science. I don\'t care.\n\nYou — keep watching the sky.
